en.title: Beethoven: String Quartet No.16 in F major, Op.135 – I. Allegretto
en.overview: This is a movement for four players in 2/4 time. It opens with a short tune in the viola. That tune comes back in the viola at the start of the last big section. Keys and chords here are estimated by computer, so some labels may be imprecise. Listen for who has the tune, for loud outbursts, and for the long quiet stretches in between.

listening_points.headline: The viola opens with the main tune
listening_points.text: The viola plays the main theme at the start [m. 1-4]. It is soft, and the other parts accompany it. The estimated key is B-flat minor, which sounds dark.

listening_points.headline: Settling into F major
listening_points.text: The estimated key moves to F major [m. 4-9]. It stays soft. The parts move as independent lines, so each one has its own path. The first violin probably takes over the lead from [m. 5].

listening_points.headline: Parts move together in D minor
listening_points.text: For a few bars the four parts move together in a block [m. 10-14]. This is called homophonic texture. The estimated key is D minor, and a fading sign is marked. The first violin probably has the top line.

listening_points.headline: Single voices step forward
listening_points.text: The texture is solo at [m. 26], with the first violin leading. At [m. 28] the second violin is solo. This is a thin, exposed moment in the middle of a soft stretch. The estimated key moves to G major at [m. 28].

listening_points.headline: A loud burst, then a hush
listening_points.text: Loud playing appears at [m. 39] and again at [m. 42-43]. A computer estimate picks [m. 43] as the loudest and busiest point of the movement. The estimated key is C major there. A fading sign at [m. 43] leads to very soft playing at [m. 44].

listening_points.headline: Quiet chords in G major
listening_points.text: The parts move together again in soft chords [m. 48-53]. The first violin leads. The mood is calm. At [m. 51] the estimated key is G major.

listening_points.headline: The cello steps out
listening_points.text: The cello is solo at [m. 63-64], and it is marked as fading. Then the viola joins in a duet at [m. 65]. The estimated key turns to A minor, which is darker.

listening_points.headline: Wandering keys, ending with a loud chord
listening_points.text: The estimated keys shift from E-flat major [m. 71] to A-flat major [m. 76] and C minor [m. 78]. A swelling sign appears at [m. 78]. Loud playing arrives at [m. 80].

listening_points.headline: Back to F major with the viola
listening_points.text: The viola is solo at [m. 81], and the estimated key is F major. Loud playing at [m. 83] soon gives way to soft at [m. 84]. The first violin leads.

listening_points.headline: New sections, new key signature
listening_points.text: The score marks a short section in tempo at [m. 89-92]. A new section with a new key signature follows at [m. 93-100]. The estimated keys pass through D major, G major and C major. Loud playing appears at [m. 92]. The lead here is uncertain and probably shared.

listening_points.headline: The opening tune returns in the viola
listening_points.text: The viola plays the main theme again [m. 101-103]. It is at the same pitch as the opening. The estimated key is F major. It starts loud and drops to soft at [m. 103]. The other parts play independent lines.

listening_points.headline: Parts join in unison in darker keys
listening_points.text: Unison or octaves means the parts play the same notes. This happens at [m. 110-112]. The estimated key is D minor, then G minor at [m. 112]. At [m. 114] it brightens to E-flat major as a duet.

listening_points.headline: Loud, jabbing accents, then very soft
listening_points.text: Loud playing begins at [m. 140]. The loudness fades at [m. 144], then drops to very soft at [m. 145]. The estimated key stays F major.

listening_points.headline: A long hush that grows
listening_points.text: The music stays very soft for a long stretch [m. 145-153]. Then it becomes soft at [m. 154]. A swelling sign appears at [m. 154-155]. The estimated key moves to C major at [m. 157], and loud playing arrives at [m. 158].

listening_points.headline: Unison accents and a darker detour
listening_points.text: Loud unison or octaves appear at [m. 176]. At [m. 180] the estimated key turns to C minor. A loud chord comes at [m. 181]. Loud unison returns at [m. 184], in an estimated E-flat major.

listening_points.headline: A soft return home to F major
listening_points.text: The estimated key is F major from [m. 187] to the end. The music stays soft. It ends with the four parts moving together in chords [m. 192-193]. The first violin probably leads.

glossary.explanation: A main tune that you can recognize when it comes back.
All parts move together, like a tune with chords.
Parts play the same notes, or the same notes at different heights.
The home note and mood of a stretch of music. Major sounds brighter. Minor sounds darker.
Each part follows its own path rather than all moving together.

zh.title: 贝多芬：F大调弦乐四重奏（第16号，Op.135）第一乐章 小快板 听赏指南
zh.overview: 这是一首2/4拍的四重奏乐章，共193小节，主调为F大调。开头由中提琴先奏出主要主题。本乐章大部分时间音量较弱，偶尔变强。分析显示第一小提琴常常是主角，但很多地方只是估计，主角可能由几件乐器共享。调性与和声均为自动估计，可能有误。

listening_points.headline: 中提琴先奏出主要主题
listening_points.text: 乐章一开始，中提琴奏出主要主题 [m. 1-3]。估计此处为降B小调，力度是弱。第2小节更弱，为很弱 [m. 2]。

listening_points.headline: 转入F大调，声部各走各的
listening_points.text: 音乐转到F大调，色彩比开头明亮 [m. 4-9]。几件乐器的旋律线相对独立，各自进行。整体仍然是弱。

listening_points.headline: 声部同步，一起前进
listening_points.text: 这里估计为D小调，织体是主调织体，即各声部节奏相近，一起前进 [m. 10-14]。第一小提琴大概是旋律所在。这里有渐弱标记。

listening_points.headline: G大调，小提琴唱旋律
listening_points.text: 调性转向G大调 [m. 15-18]。第一小提琴领奏，其余乐器伴奏。第15小节有渐强标记。

listening_points.headline: 两次独奏，小提琴交接
listening_points.text: 第26小节是独奏，第一小提琴单独演奏 [m. 26]。第28小节是第二小提琴独奏，调性为G大调 [m. 28]。这里是听辨声部的好机会。

listening_points.headline: 变强，再变得很弱
listening_points.text: 第38小节的渐强之后，第39小节变强 [m. 39]。第42至43小节再次为强，调性为C大调 [m. 42-43]。分析估计的最响最忙之处是第43小节，这只是计算机的估计。第43小节有渐弱标记，第44小节变得很弱 [m. 44]。

listening_points.headline: 安静的整齐段落
listening_points.text: 第48至53小节是主调织体，各声部齐步走 [m. 48-53]。第一小提琴大概带着旋律。第50小节起为很弱，调性转向G大调 [m. 50-51]。

listening_points.headline: 大提琴独奏
listening_points.text: 第63至64小节由大提琴独奏，声音逐渐变弱 [m. 63-64]。这里有渐弱标记。

listening_points.headline: 调性不断变换，最后变强
listening_points.text: 音乐先到降E大调，再到降A大调，最后到C小调 [m. 71-80]。第78小节有渐强标记 [m. 78]。第80小节变强 [m. 80]。

listening_points.headline: 回到F大调，中提琴独奏引路
listening_points.text: 第81小节，中提琴独奏，回到F大调 [m. 81]。第83小节突然变强，随后第84小节又变弱 [m. 83-84]。第86小节起转入A小调 [m. 86-88]。

listening_points.headline: 中间的过渡：速度回原、调号改变
listening_points.text: 第89小节标明回到原速 [m. 89]。第93小节起调号改变，先是D大调，再到G大调和C大调 [m. 93-100]。这里的主角不太明确，可能由几件乐器共享。

listening_points.headline: 主要主题回到中提琴，音高相同
listening_points.text: 第四部分开始，中提琴再次奏出主要主题 [m. 101-103]。它与开头完全一致，音高也与开头相同。此处的调性估计为F大调。一开始为强，第103小节转弱 [m. 101-103]。

listening_points.headline: 齐奏，色彩转暗
listening_points.text: 第110至112小节各声部齐奏或八度进行，大家奏同一条旋律线 [m. 110-112]。调性经D小调到G小调，色彩偏暗 [m. 109-113]。

listening_points.headline: 后段的强奏，随后转为很弱
listening_points.text: 第140至144小节为强，并有突强标记 [m. 140-144]。第144小节标有渐弱。接着第145小节变得很弱 [m. 144-145]。

listening_points.headline: 最后的转折：C小调与降E大调
listening_points.text: 第176小节有一次强的齐奏 [m. 176]。第180至181小节转入C小调，第181小节为强 [m. 180-181]。随后到降E大调，第184小节又是强的齐奏 [m. 182-184]。

listening_points.headline: 在F大调中安静收尾
listening_points.text: 最后回到F大调 [m. 187-193]。声音保持在弱的力度。最后两小节是主调织体，各声部整齐地收束 [m. 192-193]。

glossary.explanation: 几个声部节奏相近，一起前进，像合唱一样。
几件乐器奏同一条旋律，或相差八度。
音乐的中心音改变，色彩随之变亮或变暗。
大调通常听起来明亮，小调听起来较暗。
